title: 弟四章父神盘古
content_zh:
赵鸾将事情的经过讲了一遍道：“娘亲，都是陈天贵，如果不是他的话，二哥也不会成这幅模样”

见到楚秀那充满了母爱的目光，赵硕心中一暖道：“娘亲，我没事的，我可是哥哥，只要我这当哥哥的还有一口气在，就绝对不允许任何人欺负小妹”

楚秀则是一脸欣慰和赞赏的看着赵硕道：“好，硕儿说的对，只要你们兄妹和睦，娘亲就什么都不祈求了“皱了皱眉头，赵硕道：“可惜的是这次招惹了陈天贵，只怕陈天贵对小妹野心不死啊”

楚秀闻言，眸中寒光一闪，沉吟一番，看向赵鸾，赵鸾轻轻一笑道：“二哥，娘亲，你们不用担心，最多从明天开始我就不去学馆，留在家中也好帮娘亲做些事情，他陈天贵再嚣张，也不敢在光天化日之下前来咱们家闹事吧”

楚秀点了点头道：“也只有如此了”

赵硕不禁道：“可是小妹还有一年才能够结业的”

赵鸾笑了笑道：“二哥，你别忘了，小妹我可是比你聪明哦，该学的东西我都学到了，甚至比二哥你现在学到的东西还多呢，再说没有条件去学馆读书的人多了去了，比起山中乡下那些人来说，我们已经比他们强了许多了”

赵硕闻言脸上不禁露出一丝赧然，被自己妹妹如此说，就算是赵硕脸皮厚也会感到不好意思，可是谁让自己的前身的确不怎么聪明呢。(：)

见到赵硕那副尴尬的模样，楚秀伸手在赵鸾的额头点了一下道：“你这丫头，怎么能那么说你哥哥呢，枉你哥哥那么护着你”

赵鸾冲着赵硕吐了吐舌头道：“二哥，我可没笑你只是……”

楚秀看了赵硕一眼，嘴角露出一丝笑意，拉着赵鸾的手道：“好了，你就别解释了，你哥哥受了伤，让他好好的休息吧”

接下来几天中，赵鸾便留在家中帮着楚秀做些家务，没事的时候就陪着赵硕，而赵硕也没有浪费如此的机会，从赵鸾的口中得到了许多关于这个世界的事情。

传说荒古世界乃是一位上古大神自混沌之中开辟出来的，后来诞生无数的大神通者，这些大神通者参悟上古星空的运转之道继而感悟天地万物大道，当他们感悟出上古星空的奥秘之后，一个个纷纷仿效上古大神从荒古世界的边缘开辟混沌进一步的开拓荒古世界，一边壮大荒古世界，一边试图通过开天辟地来感悟更多的天地至理，完善自己的修行之道来。

而这些感悟出数道大道法则并将其彻底掌握，近乎不死不灭存在的大神通者就被称之为道主，意为大道法则之主。

当然修行无止境，法则在下，大道至上，当一些道主通过开天辟地走出自己的修行之路的时候，他们所开辟出来的世界便与荒古世界相融，同样诞生出蕴含着他们修行之道奥秘的一片星空来，而能够走出自己的修行之道，开辟出一片不亚于上古神人所开辟的古星空的星空的道主便自然超脱于古星空与一道或数道大道法则相合，成为不死不灭的伟大存在，这样的道主少之又少，因此被称之为大道主。

大道主因为触摸到了大道法则之存在，大道之下，法则长存，即为不朽。

据说除了开辟古星空的那位大道主之外，另有八位大道主走出了自己的修行之道，当他们完全开辟出新的一方星空的时候，天地震动，一方道韵显化的图卷自星空中诞生，于是被后世称之为传承星图的道韵至宝便出现了。

最初的传承星图只有九份，各自蕴含部分大道至理，更有诸多法则加持，正对应一片完整星空星辰运转之秘，可牵引一方星空之力，其强大之处就连大道主都为之侧目，此即为九份荒古级别的传承星图，也是道韵至宝的存在。

奈何上古时期诞生了无数的道主强者，这些大神通者法力无边，神通广大，*纵大道法则，运用自如，比之大道主只差一线，却不得长存，同样想要迈出最后一步领悟大道至理，成为那不死不朽的无上存在。

然而靠着他们本身的修行不知道要到什么时候才能一窥那无上大道，与大道法则相合，于是九份道韵显化并蕴含诸多法则的传承星图便成为了无上的至宝，或许通过借鉴这些天地至宝，感悟其中大道至理，他们就有机会迈出那至关重要的最后一步。

争斗厮杀开始了，能有资格争夺九大传承星图的人哪一个不是万古英豪，千秋俊杰，一个个神通广大无边，足可以毁天灭地，一场绵延亿万年的毁灭性大战，愣是将九大星空无数的星辰打的破碎，这是一个道主遍地走，道尊不如狗的荒古年代。

道，是最为玄妙的存在，天地不存而道存，自天地诞生的那一刻起，大道便贯穿古今，无所不在，其玄玄之妙，就连无上存在的大道主都说不清、道不明。

在大道伟力作用下，破碎的九大星空彻底的融合在一起，虽然还各自保留着各自的一部分星空特性，但是却的的确确的是彻底的融合，其神秘玄奥，就连那八位大道主也不禁为之惊叹。

九大传承星图即便是贵为道韵至宝，可也难免在那异宝无数的上古争斗中破碎成成千上万份散落四方，上古道主更是陨落无数，而那些陨落的上古道主身死之后，其遗骸其大无边，足以抵得上一方星系大小。

八位大道主眼看新的星空形成，昔日故友、门人弟子陨落无数，就连当初孕育他们的本源之地也破碎无数，于是八位大道主首次联手将那些陨落在无尽星空之间大多数的道主遗骸施以大神通聚集于本源之地。

道主遗骸，精、气、神化为大地、湖泊、海洋、山川草木，无数道主遗骸被强行汇聚，于是本源之地便成为了这片世界最为奇异的存在，这方由无数上古道主遗骸所化的大陆汇聚了这片世界数成的气运，加上每每有道主级别的强者陨落，总会有大神通者将其并入大陆，久而久之，这方大陆其大无边，昌盛无比。

当赵硕从赵鸾那里了解到这些的时候，赵硕心中不禁卷起滔天巨浪，遥想上古，那些大神通者颠倒乾坤、一念之间星辰破灭，真可谓是强大。

深吸一口气，赵硕看着一脸向往的赵鸾道：“小妹，不知道那位最早开辟这方世界的上古大神是何人，说来他才算是这方世界的始祖呢”

赵鸾撇了撇嘴道：“那位大神开辟了这方世界后就从未出现过，只不过后来人均尊之为盘古父神”

Zhao Luan recounted what happened and said, "Mother, it's all Chen Tiangui. If it weren't for him, my second brother wouldn't be like this."

Seeing Chu Xiu's eyes full of motherly love, Zhao Shuo felt warm in his heart and said, "Mom, I'm fine, I'm the elder brother. As long as I, the elder brother, am still alive, I will never allow anyone to bully my little sister."

Chu Xiu looked at Zhao Shuo with a look of relief and admiration and said, "Okay, Shuo'er is right. As long as you brother and sister are in harmony, my mother won't ask for anything." He frowned and Zhao Shuo said, "It's a pity that Chen Tiangui was provoked this time. I'm afraid that Chen Tiangui will not die in his ambition for my little sister."

When Chu Xiu heard the words, a cold light flashed in her eyes, she pondered for a while, looked at Zhao Luan, Zhao Luan smiled softly and said: "Second brother, mother, you don't have to worry, at most I will not go to the school from tomorrow on, I will stay at home to help my mother do something. No matter how arrogant Chen Tiangui is, he will not dare to come to our house to make trouble in broad daylight."

Chu Xiu nodded and said: "That's all."

Zhao Shuo couldn't help but said: "But my little sister still has one year to graduate."

Zhao Luan smiled and said: "Second brother, don't forget, little sister, I am smarter than you. I have learned everything I need to learn, even more than you have learned now, second brother. Besides, there are so many people who don't have the conditions to go to the academy to study. Compared to those in the mountains and countryside, we are already much better than them."

When Zhao Shuo heard this, he couldn't help showing a trace of embarrassment on his face. Being said so by his sister, even a thick-skinned Zhao Shuo would feel embarrassed, but his predecessor was indeed not very smart.(:)

Seeing Zhao Shuo's embarrassed look, Chu Xiu stretched out her hand and tapped Zhao Luan's forehead and said: "You girl, how can you say that about your brother? It's in vain that your brother protects you so much."

Zhao Luan stuck out his tongue at Zhao Shuo and said, "Second brother, I'm not laughing at you, I'm just..."

Chu Xiu glanced at Zhao Shuo, with a smile on her lips. She took Zhao Luan's hand and said, "Okay, don't explain. Your brother is injured. Let him have a good rest."

In the next few days, Zhao Luan stayed at home to help Chu Xiu with some housework, and stayed with Zhao Shuo when he had nothing to do. Zhao Shuo did not waste such an opportunity, and learned many things about the world from Zhao Luan.

Legend has it that the ancient world was created by an ancient god from chaos. Later, countless great supernatural beings were born. These great supernatural beings understood the movement of the ancient starry sky and then understood the avenues of heaven and earth. When they understood the mystery of the ancient starry sky,After that, one after another followed the example of the ancient gods to open up chaos from the edge of the ancient world and further open up the ancient world. While growing the ancient world, they tried to understand more principles of heaven and earth through the creation of the world and perfect their own way of cultivation.

And those with great supernatural powers who have comprehended several great laws and completely mastered them, and who are almost immortal, are called Tao masters, which means the masters of the great laws.

Of course, there is no end to practice, the law is at the bottom, and the road is at the top. When some Taoist masters walked out on their own path of practice through the creation of the world, the world they created merged with the ancient world, and a starry sky containing the secrets of their practice was also born, and those who can walk on itThe Taoist master who develops his own way of cultivation and creates a starry sky that is no less than the ancient starry sky created by the ancient gods and men will naturally transcend the ancient starry sky and combine with one or several Taoist laws to become an immortal and great existence. Such Taoist masters are very rare, so they are called Taoist masters.

Because the master of the avenue has touched the existence of the law of the avenue, under the avenue, the law exists forever, that is, it is immortal.

It is said that in addition to the Dao Master who opened up the ancient starry sky, eight other Dao Masters walked out on their own path of cultivation. When they completely opened up a new starry sky, the heaven and earth shook, and a scroll of Dao Yun manifested was born from the starry sky, so the Dao Yun treasure, which was called the inheritance star map by later generations, appeared.

There are only nine parts of the original inheritance star map, each of which contains some of the principles of the great truth, and is also blessed by many laws. It corresponds to the secret of the movement of stars in a complete starry sky, and can pull the power of a starry sky. Its power makes even the master of the avenue look sideways. This is the nine-part inheritance star map of the ancient level, and it is also the existence of the most precious treasure of Tao Yun.

However, countless powerful Tao masters were born in ancient times. These great supernatural beings have boundless magic power and vast supernatural powers. They can control the laws of the Tao and use them freely. They are only a few steps behind the Tao masters, but they cannot survive forever. They also want to take the last step to understand the truth of the Tao and become the immortal and supreme existence.

However, depending on their own practice, they don't know when they will be able to get a glimpse of the supreme avenue and the laws of the avenue. Therefore, the inheritance star map that manifests the Jiufen Daoyun and contains many laws has become the supreme treasure. Perhaps by learning from these treasures of heaven and earth and understanding the principles of the avenue, they will have the opportunity to take that crucial final step.

The fighting has begun. Who among the people who are qualified to compete for the nine inherited star maps is not an eternal hero, a hero of all ages, each with boundless supernatural powers, capable of destroying the world. A devastating war that lasted for hundreds of millions of years shattered countless stars in the nine stars. This was an ancient era when the Taoist masters were everywhere, and the Taoist masters were not as good as dogs.

Tao is the most mysterious existence. Heaven and earth do not exist but Tao exists. From the moment when heaven and earth were born, Tao has run through ancient and modern times and is omnipresent. Its mysterious and mysterious nature cannot even be explained clearly by the Supreme Tao Master.

Under the influence of the great power of the avenue, the nine broken starry skies were completely merged together. Although each still retained part of its own starry sky characteristics, it was indeed a complete fusion. Even the eight avenue masters could not help but be amazed by its mystery and mystery.

Even if the nine inherited star charts are the most precious treasures of Tao Yun, they will inevitably be broken into thousands of pieces and scattered in all directions during countless ancient battles. Countless ancient Taoist masters have fallen, and after the death of those fallen ancient Taoist masters, their remains are so huge that they are as big as a galaxy.

The eight Avenue Masters saw the new starry sky forming. Countless former friends and disciples had fallen, and even the place of origin that had given birth to them had been shattered countless times. Therefore, the eight Avenue Lords joined forces for the first time to use great supernatural powers to gather the remains of most of the Taoist Masters who had fallen among the endless starry sky in the place of origin.

The remains of Tao masters, essence, energy, and gods were transformed into the earth, lakes, oceans, mountains, rivers, and vegetation. The remains of countless Tao masters were forcibly gathered, and the place of origin became the most bizarre existence in the world. This place was composed of countless ancient Taoists.The continent where the master's remains were transformed has gathered tens of percent of the world's luck. In addition, every time a powerful person at the Tao Master level dies, there will always be a person with great supernatural powers who merges it into the continent. Over time, this continent becomes boundless and prosperous.

When Zhao Shuo learned this from Zhao Luan, Zhao Shuo couldn't help but feel huge waves in his heart. He thought about the ancient times, when those with great supernatural powers turned the world upside down and shattered the stars in a single thought. They were really powerful.

Taking a deep breath, Zhao Shuo looked at Zhao Luan who looked longingly and said: "Little sister, I don't know who the ancient god was who first opened up this world. It is said that he is the ancestor of this world."

Zhao Luan curled his lips and said: "That great god has never appeared since he opened up this world, but later everyone respected him as Father God Pangu."
